_help: Secondary profile (Gavin t199u 11/03, t200u 11/04). Tynamo line is the secondary; Eternatus (890) is primary.
name: Eelektross
ability: Levitate (Tynamo, Eelektrik, Eelektross) - immune to Ground moves
secondary_rules: Keep alive. Gets heals, Soothe Bells, Revives. Toxic Orb -> Tynamo line (Poison Heal passive heals it); never cure its poison. Never Flame Orb.
doubles_rule: In double battles while a Tynamo-line mon is the primary's partner on the field, the primary may use Earthquake (spread Ground moves) freely - the partner is immune. Never Earthquake while a wild shiny is on the field.
mega: Mega Bracelet (rank -380), then Eelektrossite (rank -370, only while Eelektross 604 alive; applied to Eelektross only) -> Mega Eelektross.
evolution: Tynamo->Eelektrik at Lv39; Thunder Stone -> Eelektrik (603) to evolve into Eelektross (604); Thunder Stone ranks -360 while Eelektrik is in party (above Nugget/money).
